punchline: Meadows's students said her hand made the Slinky bounce, so she did the same move with the empty box and nothing happened.
thirty_sec: Donella Meadows used to put a Slinky on her palm, hold it from above and pull her lower hand away. It bounces up and down. Students say: your hand did it. Then she does the same with the Slinky's box, and it just hangs there. The bounce was in the spring all along. Her point is that systems largely produce their own behavior, which is why, she says, competitors rarely cause a company to lose market share.
